**“Every work is my work. We complete every challenge as one team.”**

 Your designation tells us your expertise.

 📈
 **What This Opportunity Can Become** 




 We don't want your next five years to simply add five years to your resume.
 



 We want those years to fundamentally change what you're capable of.
 



 Your growth at AI Unika will come from the problems you can solve, the products you can own, the responsibility you can handle and the impact you create. As your capability grows, your responsibility can grow with it.

 , with the final compensation determined based on experience, technical capability, practical problem\-solving ability, interview performance and overall suitability.
 



 We understand that salary is important. Everyone deserves fair compensation for their work.
 



 But there is something we want to be very clear about.
 



**If you're looking for this role only because you want a salary hike or a bigger number on your CTC, this may not be the right opportunity for you.**

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
   

  

 As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will design, build, and maintain production\-grade backend services and web applications that power personalisation and recommendation capabilities. You will work closely with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Product Owners, and Data Engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and low\-latency services.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop production\-grade APIs and service layers that expose personalisation and recommendations to consuming applications and digital experience layers.
* Build and evolve web\-based applications and user experiences.
* Build model\-serving and inference integration layers that support real\-time and batch recommendation patterns.
* Implement reliable, scalable, and low\-latency services with strong focus on resiliency, observability, and performance.
* Work with caching, event\-driven processing and distributed systems patterns to support high\-volume consumer use cases.
* Collaborate with Tech Leads, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineering and Product teams to deliver roadmap commitments.
* Drive technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions within the team.
* Ensure applications and services are production\-ready through effective observability, monitoring, performance optimisation, reliability engineering, and operational readiness practices.
* Mentor junior engineers, perform code reviews and help establish engineering standards and best practices.
* Utilise AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate development and strengthen code quality.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 7\+ years of experience designing and building scalable, resilient, and maintainable microservices and web applications in modern cloud environments.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for building production backend services.
* Frontend development experience with React framework strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of system design and distributed architecture.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems fundamentals including concurrency, asynchronous processing, idempotency, exception handling and circuit breakers.
* Strong data structures and algorithms foundation with experience applying them to real\-world use cases.
* Experience with event\-driven architecture using Kafka or similar technologies.
* Experience with SQL/No\-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs into production applications will be a strong advantage.
* Understanding of embedding\-based similarity search and vector databases is an advantage.
* Strong ability to mentor engineers, review designs, and drive sound technical decisions.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is preferred.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

 You are in expert in multiple technical areas and make your mark as a business domain expert as well. This is evidenced in your delivery track record and your ability to execute your individual responsibilities and to provide your expertise and support to colleagues when needed.
 



 Senior Analyst Developers own non\-functional requirements and are responsible for ensuring that their code complies with coding standards, is secure and performs well.

* Understanding of web services.

* Confident, and able to take a lead role in a delivery\-focused environment.
* Experience of working with different levels of stakeholders within a project environment.
* Independent, self\-directing working style.
* Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic fast\-paced industry;.
* Enjoy working as part of a high\-performance team.
* Hard\-working, innovative and takes pride in their work.
* Passionate about creating innovative solutions for customers.

 Our culture is what drives us. It's at the heart of who we are and everything we do. It's what inspires, excites and moves us forward. Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world.  That’s why we value the strength and diversity of thought in our global team.

* Customer obsessed for the long\-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way
* Challenge, commit and win together



  





**Read more about The FNZ Way and our values** 
 : www.fnz.com/culture

* Right from day one, you will work alongside exceptional, multicultural teams \- experts in their respective fields \- who will inspire and challenge you to make your greatest impact.
* Be part of a highly successful, rapidly growing, global business that is leading the delivery of financial services via cloud computing and partners with some of the world’s largest companies;

* Remuneration, significant financial rewards and career advancement is based on individual contribution and business impact rather than tenure or seniority;

We embrace the unique perspective and capabilities of our current and future employees, which will help us continue to drive innovation and achieve our business goals.
